name: manual_a9a1dc
claim: GLM-5.2 safe defaults and error recovery: (1) API key in secrets, environment file auto-sourced, health check with 10s connect + 120s max timeout + 3 retries. (2) Exit codes drive fallback: 0=success, 7/28/52=try next. (3) Setup is idempotent: setup-glm52.sh adds sourcing to shell profiles once; re-runs are safe no-ops. (4) Status visible at startup: every orchestrator run prints whether GLM-5.2 is ACTIVE or NOT AVAILABLE. (5) Operators always know fallback state; silent failures are prevented; diagnostics are available via shell history and endpoint testing.
conditions: glm52 error recovery health check safe defaults idempotent setup

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04: GLM-5.2 fallback must be robust with clear error handling and status visibility. Safe defaults prevent silent failures; logging enables diagnostics; idempotent setup prevents multi-entry issues.
